title: Step 2: Schema & migrations
summary: Db2 DDL for 5 per-type tables, vector indexes, minimal migration runner.
description:
Design and write the Db2 DDL for the four per-type memory tables (working,
episodic, semantic_facts, entity_profiles, procedural), per the Step 0
decisions. For each table include: id, tenant_id, agent_id, user_id,
thread_id, content (CLOB or VARCHAR based on expected size), metadata
(JSON column), embedding (VECTOR(<dim>, FLOAT32) NOT NULL — default to a
zero-vector if none provided, document why), created_at, updated_at,
expires_at (nullable), version, deleted_at (nullable, for soft-delete).

Use the Product Knowledge MCP tool to verify the exact current `VECTOR`
column DDL syntax, `CREATE VECTOR INDEX` clause options, and DiskANN
parameters/limitations before finalizing the DDL.

Add CREATE VECTOR INDEX statements per table using DiskANN with a documented
distance metric choice per type (justify cosine vs euclidean per table).
Add supporting indexes for the scoping columns (tenant_id, agent_id,
user_id, thread_id).

Build a minimal SQL migration runner (`db/migrations/`, numbered .sql files
+ a `migrate.py` that applies pending ones and tracks applied versions in a
`schema_migrations` table) — do not pull in alembic.

comments.text: Schema complete. 0001_schema_migrations.sql + 0002_memory_tables.sql. Five tables: working_memory, episodic_memory, semantic_facts, entity_profiles, procedural_memory. All columns per spec: id VARCHAR(36), scope cols VARCHAR(128), content CLOB(65536), metadata VARCHAR(4096), embedding VECTOR(1536,FLOAT32) NOT NULL DEFAULT VECTOR_FILL zero-vector, timestamps, version, deleted_at. CREATE VECTOR INDEX WITH DISTANCE COSINE on all five. Composite scope index + agent-only index + partial expires_at index per table. schema_migrations tracking table. Migrator class in db/migrate.py — stdlib only, no alembic. bootstrap is idempotent (check-before-create). 14 unit tests via SQLite fake pool, 24 total passing. ARCHITECTURE.md section 3 updated. DECISIONS.md entries: CLOB/VARCHAR/COSINE/1536-dim/zero-vec rationale all recorded.
